jobs.title: US Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
US Marketing Lead

Location: United States

Reports to: VP of Marketing

Employment type: Full-time

About Teton

Teton is building the autonomous operating system for care. Our technology gives senior living and care teams greater visibility into resident wellbeing, movement, sleep, and care delivery, helping them respond faster, work more efficiently, and provide more personalized care.

We are growing quickly across the United States and are looking for a US Marketing Lead to own our regional marketing strategy and execution.

The Role

The US Marketing Lead will be the territory owner for Teton’s growth and brand presence in the United States.

You will translate Teton’s global positioning and company priorities into a focused US marketing plan that creates demand, strengthens our reputation, and helps the sales team win. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the regional strategy, build campaigns, produce sales materials, support events, coordinate PR, and measure what is working.

You will work closely with US Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Events, Growth, and external partners. You will report to the VP of Marketing and serve as the primary marketing partner for the US commercial team.

What You’ll Own

US Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the US marketing plan in alignment with company revenue goals and global marketing priorities.

  • Identify the audiences, markets, partnerships, and channels most likely to drive growth.

  • Adapt Teton’s global campaigns and positioning for the US senior living and care market.

  • Maintain a clear regional campaign calendar, budget, and set of priorities.

  • Bring insights from customers, prospects, competitors, and the market back into the broader marketing organization.

Demand Generation and Campaigns

  • Partner with Growth Lead to build and run integrated campaigns across email, paid media, content, webinars, events, partnerships, and other relevant channels.

  • Create campaigns around Teton’s most important customer problems and product capabilities.

  • Own regional email strategy, segmentation, nurture programs, and campaign follow-up.

  • Work with Growth to improve lead generation, conversion, and account engagement.

  • Develop targeted programs for priority accounts, operator groups, and strategic market segments.

  • Ensure leads are properly captured, routed, followed up on, and measured in HubSpot.

Sales Enablement

  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to the US sales organization.

  • Develop and maintain US-specific sales decks, case studies, one-pagers, proposals, follow-up materials, and campaign assets.

  • Translate product capabilities into clear operational and commercial value for senior living operators.

  • Equip sales with the proof points, customer stories, and market insights needed to move opportunities forward.

  • Support account-based campaigns for strategic prospects and active opportunities.

  • Gather regular feedback from Sales and Customer Success to identify gaps in messaging, content, and enablement.

Events, Webinars, and Partnerships

  • Partner with the Events lead to determine which US conferences, webinars, executive gatherings, and field programs deserve investment.

  • Build pre-event, on-site, and post-event campaigns that generate meetings and measurable pipeline.

  • Support speaker submissions, presentations, sponsorships, customer participation, and event messaging.

  • Develop regional partnerships with associations, media organizations, technology partners, and other industry stakeholders.

  • Ensure events are connected to broader campaigns rather than treated as standalone activities.

Content, Customer Stories, and PR

  • Identify strong US customer stories and work with Customer Success to turn them into case studies, testimonials, videos, and campaign assets.

  • Develop content that reflects the priorities and language of US senior living operators.

  • Work with internal subject-matter experts to produce thought leadership, educational content, reports, and webinars.

  • Coordinate with Teton’s PR partners on announcements, contributed articles, awards, speaking opportunities, and media relationships.

  • Help establish Teton and its leadership as credible voices in the US senior living market.

Product Positioning and Market Intelligence

  • Localize global product positioning for US audiences while maintaining consistency with Teton’s overall narrative.

  • Develop messaging for different US customer segments, buyer roles, and stages of the sales process.

  • Monitor competitors, category trends, customer needs, and changes in the senior living market.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to support launches and communicate new capabilities effectively.

  • Ensure US market feedback is reflected in future campaigns, content, and product messaging.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Define regional goals and report on campaign performance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, event results, and channel effectiveness.

  • Maintain clear dashboards and regular updates for Marketing and US commercial leadership.

  • Use performance data to improve targeting, messaging, campaign investment, and sales follow-up.

  • Establish a consistent process for evaluating what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will have:

  • Established a clear and credible US marketing strategy tied to Teton’s commercial goals.

  • Built a consistent campaign engine that generates qualified demand and supports pipeline growth.

  • Improved the quality and consistency of US sales enablement.

  • Created a repeatable approach to US events, webinars, partnerships, and account-based programs.

  • Expanded Teton’s library of US customer proof points and case studies.

  • Increased Teton’s visibility and credibility with senior living operators and industry stakeholders.

  • Created transparent reporting that shows how US marketing contributes to revenue.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in healthcare technology, senior living, or enterprise software industry.

  • Experience owning a regional, vertical, or business-unit marketing strategy.

  • A track record of building integrated campaigns that contribute to pipeline and revenue.

  • Strong sales enablement experience and the ability to work closely with enterprise sales teams.

  • Experience with events, content, email marketing, webinars, account-based marketing, and demand generation.

  • Excellent writing, editing, messaging, and presentation skills.

  • Strong project-management skills and the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.

  • Comfort working in a fast-growing company where priorities can change and processes are still being built.

  • Strong analytical judgment and experience using marketing and CRM data to make decisions.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and related marketing tools is preferred.

  • Knowledge of the US senior living or healthcare market is highly valuable.

The Person We Think Will Thrive

You are a strong generalist who knows how to turn company goals into focused regional execution. You can write a campaign brief, improve a sales deck, develop an event plan, interview a customer, analyze lead performance, and present a clear recommendation to leadership.

You are commercially minded, comfortable working directly with sales, and focused on producing work that helps the company grow. You bring structure without creating unnecessary process, and you know how to balance brand building with near-term pipeline needs.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. In this role, you will translate privacy requirements into effective, repeatable processes across the company and drive the day-to-day operation of key privacy initiatives.

You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and continuously improve ElevenLabs’ global privacy program, translating legal and regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes and controls.

  • Own and coordinate privacy compliance workflows across frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, HIPAA, and applicable biometric privacy requirements.

  • Manage privacy impact assessment processes, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and assessments involving AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security teams to operationalize privacy-by-design throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Maintain data inventories, records of processing activities (RoPAs), data flow documentation, and other privacy governance records.

  • Manage processes for data subject and consumer rights requests, including access, deletion, correction, and opt-out requests, and help ensure requests are handled consistently and within applicable deadlines.

  • Partner with Security and Legal on third-party and vendor privacy assessments, data processing requirements, and privacy-related risk remediation.

  • Support privacy incident response and regulatory or customer inquiries by coordinating documentation, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions.

  • Implement and administer privacy tooling and automation to improve the efficiency and scalability of privacy operations including maintaining ElevenLabs’ consent management platform and partnering with Legal, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure cookie, tracking technology, and other consent and preference mechanisms are appropriately configured, documented, monitored, and updated as our products and regulatory requirements evolve.

  • Develop privacy program metrics, dashboards, and reporting to track compliance, identify risks, and communicate program maturity and priorities to stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance.

  • Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company.

Who you are

  • Excited by AI and emerging technologies and interested in solving novel privacy challenges involving voice, biometrics, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

  • Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams.

  • Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company.

  • Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements.

  • Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation.

  • Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience managing consent management platforms and cookie/tracking technology compliance, including consent configuration, preference management, and coordination with technical and marketing teams.

  • Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar.

  • Privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT are a plus.

  • Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Want to join a team of passionate people who want to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer?

👋 About us

Skin Analytics is an award-winning, health tech company that deploys world-leading skin cancer pathways using AI as a medical device, DERM.

Following our recent £15M series B funding, regulatory milestones hit, and doubling from 50 to 100 headcount in 2025, we're ready to scale further internationally, making history for AI in healthcare and the future of dermatology.

We're proud to epitomise AI for good - with a Class III CE mark, DERM is the only AI as a medical device approved to make clinical decisions autonomously in the cancer space, as well as being the first company to receive a NICE recommendation for use across the NHS.*

DERM is deployed at more than 28 NHS organisations where we enable patients to gain significantly quicker access to skin cancer diagnosis. If that's not enough, we also collaborate with some of the largest health insurers to reach patients in their own homes.

We are a team of passionate people on a mission to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer.

Brief overview
This role owns the messaging architecture that underpins everything the marketing function produces. Builds and maintains the positioning and messaging platform that makes the company's strategic transition commercially effective across multiple products, markets, and audiences. Operating in close partnership with Product and commercial leadership, the output will directly impact how products are understood and adopted at a system and national level.

Responsibilities

Messaging and Positioning

  • Builds and maintains the core messaging framework across DERM audience platforms. Defines positioning, value proposition, proof points, and claims by product, audience and market

  • NHS strategic narrative: Develop the positioning for product transitions, and future lifecycle stages, articulating a clinically credible and scalable adoption pathway. Defines how Skin Analytics differentiates from competitors and makes the case for systemic adoption in primary and secondary care.

  • Defines the strategic positioning and competitive differentiation for international expansion in partnership with commercial leadership. Sets the foundation the PMM executes against.

  • Define and build Market entry positioning for priority International markets, accounting for differences in healthcare system structure, clinical procurement culture, and regulatory context in each geography

Claims Governance

  • Build and maintain the claims library in conjunction with Medical Director / Research teams. Define the process and governance for adding, updating, and retiring claims, ensuring the team can produce compliant content at speedy sign-off.

  • Works with Clinical and Innovation teams to understand forthcoming clinical evidence and ensures marketing positioning is built to leverage it.

Sales Enablement

  • Develops the Sales Enablement Framework for commercial teams: battle cards, pitch decks, case study briefs, objection handling, and market-specific materials.

  • Ensures the PMM delivers the sales enablement content, and it is built, stored, and tracked so commercial teams have a single, current resource base and adoption can be actively measured.

  • Run structured win/loss analysis and translate findings into updated messaging, positioning, and enablement materials with clear commercial accountability for outcomes

Go-to-Market

  • Owns the go-to-market process for new products (launch playbooks) and product updates.

  • Briefs the Marketing Manager on digital content requirements based on messaging framework, ensuring campaign execution is consistent across all channels

Accountable for

  • Win rate and sales cycle length, improvement attributed to sales enablement quality

  • Claims library completeness and adoption rate by team

  • Launch readiness, integrated with product team to ensure products launched with complete messaging and enablement on time

  • Commercial team satisfaction with PMM output, measured through regular and structured feedback

Required Experience

  • Demonstrated track record developing and owning positioning and messaging frameworks for complex B2B products in a multi-market, multi-audience environment. Healthcare, medtech, or clinical SaaS experience is strongly preferred.

  • Proven ability to design and synthesise market, customer, and competitive intelligence into positioning that differentiates the product. Previous evidence that intelligence directly shaped positioning decisions and commercial differentiation.

  • Experience running structured win/loss analysis and ability to translate findings into updated messaging and sales enablement with measurable commercial impact.

  • Experience working between product, commercial, and marketing teams to translate product capability into commercially compelling narratives.

  • End to end GTM ownership across the full launch lifecycle: strategy, goal setting, cross functional alignment, execution, measurement, and post-launch review.

  • Evidence of managing conflicting priorities and tensions across different functions and products.

  • Proficient with HubSpot reporting and attribution tools to measure the commercial impact of PMM output: win rates, deal velocity, and enablement adoption rates. (or equivalent experience on Salesforce)

  • AI Literacy Actively uses AI tools as part of day-to-day workflow: competitive intelligence synthesis, market research, positioning iteration, and sales enablement development.

  • Comfortable with prompt engineering for efficient content and research tasks; able to produce high-quality, on-brand materials at pace using AI tooling.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary

📈 Share options package - all our employees have ownership in the company

🏥 Private healthcare

💸 Company pension incl. salary sacrifice options

🌴 25 days annual leave + 5 day company shutdown in August + bank holidays

👪 Enhanced parental leave - includes adoption & foster

🐣 Yellownest Salary Sacrifice Nursery Scheme - save with workplace nursery scheme

🚲 Bike to work scheme

💻 Training budget

🤝 Weekly catch-ups, monthly meetings to talk about you, your ambitions and work on your development

🎊 Lots of fun social activities!

Our Values

🌱 Building a Strong Foundation

🎓 Always Learning

🏅 Lead from the Front

💪 Tough and Resilient

The Real Stuff

The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. If you need any adjustments during our hiring process, you can indicate that at the next step.

jobs.title: Clinical Data & Quality Manager
jobs.description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words

Within QARA, you oversee Good Clinical Practice compliance across Resilience’s sponsored studies and studies conducted with pharmaceutical partners. You combine clinical quality, data integrity and system qualification, working closely with the teams running studies and building data workflows.

Your impact

You help keep studies inspection-ready, data reliable and traceable, and compliance embedded in everyday work. Your role is to safeguard the framework and help teams apply it, rather than produce the data yourself.

Your day-to-day work

  • Oversee study GCP compliance, manage deviations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and conduct quality and Trial Master File (TMF) reviews.

  • Maintain inspection readiness and support CRO oversight in line with ICH E6(R3).

  • Qualify systems, assess test environments and review data extractions, audit trails and Data Management Plans.

  • Work with Data and Clinical teams to build compliance into data workflows from the outset.

  • Maintain clinical quality procedures, train teams and monitor regulatory developments.

This is not a site-monitoring, data-engineering, study-project-management or routine clinical data-production role.

✨ Your Team

Here, we don’t work in silos. You’ll join an agile structure where compliance is truly a team sport:

  • Your Manager: Yasmine, the guardian of regulatory compliance for our medical devices. She will share her strategic vision of the healthcare sector with you and will be your go-to for the most sensitive decisions.

  • Your core team: A trio of passionate experts. They’re your daily contacts for everything related to the quality management system, technical files, and audit preparation.

  • The team’s little extra: A unique context where safety, clinical, and regulatory aspects come together to better serve patients, led by a team that combines rigor and kindness.

You join QARA and report directly to Yasmine. You work with Clinical Operations, Clinical Scientists, Data and Translational Research, as well as the DPO, CROs and pharmaceutical partners.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Apply ICH E6(R3), Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to clinical studies and systems.

  • Manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and inspection preparation, beyond data cleaning alone.

  • Qualify systems using CSV/CSQ approaches and apply ALCOA+ principles.

  • Work with EDC systems and ePRO/eCOA solutions, translating their requirements into practical controls.

  • Communicate and write fluently in English.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • A rigorous approach that takes operational constraints into account.

  • Practical judgement to turn requirements into workable processes.

  • The ability to influence and train colleagues rather than impose rules.

  • Confidence working across clinical and technical teams and with external partners.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Gained at least five years of relevant experience in Clinical Data Management and GCP compliance within a pharmaceutical company or CRO.

  • Handled clinical quality topics such as deviations, audits, inspections or procedures.

  • Contributed to computerised system qualification.

  • Worked with EDC systems, such as Medidata Rave, Veeva or Oracle, and ePRO/eCOA solutions.

It’s a plus if you

  • Understand pipelines, ETL and databases, without needing to be a developer.

  • Know CDISC standards for regulatory submissions.

  • Want to move from data production to compliance oversight and help build quality practices.

💛 Why join us?

  • Contribute to reliable studies and data that support clinical research in oncology.

  • Combine clinical quality, data integrity and collaboration with technical teams.

  • Work remotely from France and meet colleagues at internal company events.

🤝 Recruitment Process

  1. Initial conversation with Elena.

  2. Interview with Yasmine, your future manager.

  3. Case study with Sarah and Yasmine from QARA.

  4. Team conversation with Nicoleta, Bertille and Alric.

  5. Strategic interview with Raph.

GDPR : Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. They will be available only for people involved in the process and erased after 2 years of inactivity.

Under GDPR and as Resilience attach great importance to privacy, please note that you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased. jobs.title: Head of Crypto
jobs.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As the Head of Crypto, you will be the driving force behind a brand new, core pillar of Satispay's expansion into the cryptocurrency and Web3 space. We already have a high-potential strategy in place—your mission is to take the reins, execute it flawlessly, adapt it when necessary, and expand upon it wherever possible.

Given the strategic importance of this initiative to Satispay, you will work with a high degree of autonomy and have direct, frequent touchpoints with the Satispay founding team to align on execution, team scaling, and long-term vision.

Here’s what that looks like in practice:

  • Hire & Build Your Team: Identify talent needs, recruit, and structure a dedicated, high-performing cross-functional team from the ground up to bring Satispay's crypto vertical to life.

  • Execution & Strategic Evolution: Take ownership of our existing crypto roadmap. Drive its execution to deliver immediate impact, while continuously evaluating the market to make necessary adjustments and expand our offerings when new opportunities arise.

  • Executive Collaboration: Partner directly with the founders and C-level executives to ensure the crypto rollout continuously aligns with the company's ultimate mission to simplify everyday finance.

  • Product Development: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our crypto products—from infrastructure setup and go-to-market strategy to launch and continuous optimization.

  • Regulatory Navigation: Work in lockstep with the Compliance and Legal teams to ensure all products align perfectly with evolving European regulations (such as MiCA) and safeguarding standards.

  • Strategic Partnerships: Identify and establish crucial relationships with key players in the crypto ecosystem, including exchanges, custodians, liquidity providers, and blockchain networks.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

What we're looking for

We are seeking for an execution-focused, and product-minded leader with a deep passion for digital assets that matches our company culture.

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in crypto/Web3 initiatives at a regulated Fintech, exchange, or crypto-native company.

  • Team Building: experience hiring, managing, and scaling specialized, high-performing teams in a fast-paced tech or financial environment.

  • Master of Execution: ability to take a high-level strategy and turn it into shipped products, scaling operations effectively from the ground up.

  • Industry & Market Expertise: Deep, technical understanding of blockchain architecture, crypto market dynamics, digital wallets, custody solutions, and Web3 infrastructure.

  • Regulatory Awareness: Solid knowledge of the European crypto regulatory landscape (e.g., MiCA, AML/KYC for digital assets) and a history of launching products within a strict compliance framework.

  • Strategic Adaptability: Ability to balance bold expansion with stringent risk management

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent ability to align internal and external stakeholders, translating complex crypto concepts into clear, actionable business updates for the founding team.

  • Language Proficiency: You are completely fluent in English. Knowledge of Italian is considered a plus.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impacts are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

  • Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses.

  • Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding.

  • Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

  • Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world.

That’s why we created CareAbout:

Wir suchen Menschen, die offen kommunizieren, Wissen teilen, Feedback konstruktiv aufnehmen und auch andere Perspektiven aktiv einbeziehen.

Als Art Director entwickelst du gemeinsam mit Strateg:innen und Berater:innen überzeugende kreative und visuelle Antworten auf komplexe, unternehmerische Fragestellungen. jobs.title: Deployment Engineer (Intern or Recent Graduate)
jobs.description:
Flink Robotics is a fast-paced startup, out of ETH Zurich's Computational Robotics Lab, building autonomous robots that can handle any item - including ones they've never seen before. We're revolutionising material handling, from stacking boxes to sorting parcels and unloading goods.

We’re looking for a hands-on Deployment Engineer Intern who loves debugging and stress-testing, ready to help install robots that move the world’s parcels. From day one, you'll be out with our field team at customer sites, ensuring every system is rigorously tested, commissioned and continuously improved.

Who you are

  • Eager to join a VC-backed startup and take on real responsibility from the start

  • Passionate about robotics: from mechanics and electronics to computer vision and control

  • Proactive, curious and a clear communicator (fluent English, German is a strong plus)

  • Ready to travel 50-100% to customer sites and adapt to different teams and fast-changing environments on the shop floor

  • Swiss or EU/ citizen / at a Swiss university / valid work permit

What you bring

  • A degree (completed or in progress) in mechatronics, mechanical engineering (design / manufacturing focus) or electrical / electronics engineering

  • First experiences in commissioning complex electromechanical or robotic systems in the field

  • Strong hardware / software troubleshooting skills and stakeholder experience across technical and operational levels

  • Bonus: prior robot deployments, personal/academic robotics projects, CAD exposure (SolidWorks/Inventor/Fusion 360) and basic GD&T, extra languages, driver's license, familiarity with Linux

What you'll do

  • Support assembly, configuration and tests of our robots in the lab and on-site

  • Help plan and execute on-site installations for a smooth customer handover

  • Tune perception and motion modules in production

  • Train operators and provide hands-on support during ramp-up, gather insights for our product roadmap

  • Diagnose and fix hardware/software issues remotely and on-site

  • Represent Flink at customer demos, pilots and trade shows

  • Feed field data back to engineering to unlock new use cases

Why join

  • An ambitious team building a product with huge potential

  • Cutting-edge robotics problems

  • Competitive salary and top-tier gear

  • Based in Zurich, with travel to partners worldwide

Apply now if you’re ready to push boundaries and help shape the future of robotics!

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager, Regional Enterprise
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

What you'll be doing

In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
  • Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
  • Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
  • Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
  • Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
  • You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
  • You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
  • You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
  • You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
  • You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
  • You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English. 

What we offer

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps

If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you.

After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

What you'll be doing

In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
  • Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
  • Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
  • Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
  • Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
  • You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
  • You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
  • You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
  • You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
  • You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
  • You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English. 

What we offer

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps

If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you.

After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Solutions Architect f/m/d
jobs.description:
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Why this role

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

  • High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.
  • High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.
  • High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.
  • Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

What you will do

  • Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.
  • Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.
  • Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.
  • Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.
  • Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.
  • Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.
  • Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.
  • Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.

How you work

  • You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.
  • You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.
  • You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.
  • You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.
  • You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.

Who you work with

Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. 

What you bring

Must have

  • Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms
  • Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design
  • Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents
  • A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day
  • Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams
  • Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal
  • Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions
  • Clear, structured documentation habits
  • Fluent English and French skills
  • Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK

Strong plus

  • Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)
  • Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations
  • Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects
  • Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms
  • SQL and BI fundamentals

How we measure success

  • Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter
  • Customer satisfaction with your contribution
  • Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents
  • Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern
  • Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted

Your first 90 days

  • Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.
  • Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.
  • Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

 

What We Offer

Culture & Growth

  • A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
  • Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

  • Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
  • Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

jobs.description:
UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT

Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen.
Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 30.000 Handwerker:innen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen.
Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen.

DEINE MISSION BEI UNS

Als Team Lead Customer Support (f/m/d) bist du verantwortlich für die Führung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Customer Support Teams. Du baust einen skalierbaren, AI-gestützten und datengetriebenen Support auf, der unseren Kund:innen ein erstklassiges Serviceerlebnis bietet. Dabei verbindest du operatives Tagesgeschäft mit strategischer Weiterentwicklung, optimierst Prozesse und förderst dein Team gezielt in seiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung. Mit smarten Automatisierungen, klaren KPIs und einem starken Team schaffst du die Grundlage dafür, unseren Customer Support nachhaltig zu skalieren.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du führst, coachst und entwickelst unsere Customer Support Specialists weiter – mit regelmäßigem Feedback und gezielten Trainings begleitest du sie auf ihrem Weg vom Junior zum Mid-Level und Senior.

  • Du verantwortest das operative Tagesgeschäft im Support und stellst sicher, dass Tickets effizient zugewiesen, priorisiert und gemäß unseren SLAs und Qualitätsstandards bearbeitet werden.

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Eskalationen und komplexe Kundenanfragen und übernimmst selbst anspruchsvolle oder dringende Supportfälle.

  • Du analysierst und optimierst relevante Support-KPIs wie Erreichbarkeit, Antwort- und Lösungszeiten, Ticket-Backlog und Kundenzufriedenheit.

  • Du optimierst die Einsatzplanung, Aufgabenverteilung und Supportprozesse, um die Kundenerreichbarkeit in der ersten Phase auf mindestens 60 % zu steigern.

  • Du treibst unseren AI-gestützten First-Level-Support voran – mit dem Ziel, mindestens 50 % aller eingehenden Tickets automatisiert zu lösen, ohne Abstriche bei der Servicequalität zu machen.

  • Du erkennst Entwicklungspotenziale im Team und verbesserst die Performance durch gezieltes Coaching, Qualitätskontrollen und regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Knowledge Base kontinuierlich weiter und stellst sicher, dass Hilfeartikel und Supportressourcen aktuell, verständlich und relevant bleiben.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Head of Customer Success zusammen, um die Supportstrategie weiterzuentwickeln, KPIs wöchentlich zu überprüfen und operative Verbesserungen umzusetzen.

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit RevOps, Customer Success und Product zusammen, um Kundenfeedback einzubringen, wiederkehrende Probleme zu lösen und weitere AI-Automatisierungspotenziale zu identifizieren.

DEIN PROFIL

Must-haves

jobs.title: Regional Director Sales - CEUR
Solutions Architect f/m/d
jobs.description:
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Why this role

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

  • High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.
  • High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.
  • High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.
  • Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

What you will do

  • Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.
  • Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.
  • Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.
  • Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.
  • Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.
  • Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.
  • Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.
  • Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.

How you work

  • You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.
  • You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.
  • You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.
  • You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.
  • You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.

Who you work with

Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. 

What you bring

Must have

  • Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms
  • Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design
  • Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents
  • A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day
  • Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams
  • Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal
  • Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions
  • Clear, structured documentation habits
  • Fluent English and German skills
  • Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK

Strong plus

  • Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)
  • Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations
  • Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects
  • Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms
  • SQL and BI fundamentals

How we measure success

  • Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter
  • Customer satisfaction with your contribution
  • Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents
  • Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern
  • Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted

Your first 90 days

  • Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.
  • Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.
  • Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

 

What We Offer

Culture & Growth

  • A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
  • Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

  • Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
  • Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
  • Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.
