jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
About Foundation Health

Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.

We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.

The Role

You'd be one of the first QA hires in the UK, working alongside our UK QA Lead to build how we do quality here: frameworks, standards and process, with no legacy test debt to dig out of. Everybody here is hands-on, and that's what this role is: in the detail, every day.

Before anything we build reaches a pharmacist's queue in the US, someone has to decide it's ready. That's you. If you take pride in what ships, and you'll say "this isn't ready" even when everyone wants it out the door, you'll fit right in.

We've built an AI operating system for pharmacies, tackling the operational infrastructure behind things like paperwork and care coordination. It's in production with enterprise health systems across the US, and we're working directly with one of the biggest names in pharmacy.

What you'll actually do

  • Help shape our UK QA practice with the QA Lead: frameworks, standards and how we work day to day

  • Write automated tests in Playwright and test our APIs with Postman, across a serverless stack of Node.js, TypeScript, SvelteKit and GCP

  • Test AI-powered features in production, including agentic workflows and LLM outputs, and help build the evals that tell us whether they're behaving

  • Do proper manual testing, regression and UAT when a release needs it, and know when that beats automation

  • Work closely with engineers to catch issues early, so moving fast never comes at the cost of the product

Who you are

  • You've got the experience. You have 3+ years in QA or software testing, with solid work on web apps and APIs.

  • You're strong with Playwright. You also have a good instinct for when to automate and when to test by hand.

  • You know what's at stake. You've worked on enterprise products, so you understand what happens when something breaks.

  • You actually use AI. It's already part of how you work, or you've tested AI-powered products and know why it's a different problem.

  • You care about the outcome. Quality matters to you as a result, not as a process to tick off.

The setup

Hybrid, Manchester city centre, 1-2 days a week in the office. When you're working out what "correct" even means for an AI system, a whiteboard and the right three people in a room beat a Slack thread every time.

Not local? We offer relocation support for the right person.

We're Series A, there's early equity, and the work genuinely changes how people get their medication.

About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

We are seeking a commercially minded Senior Manager to join Volta's tax function and lead delivery on deals, structuring, and modelling. This role would suit someone looking to move in-house at a fast-scaling, capital-intensive platform.

Reporting to the VP of Tax, this is a hands-on delivery role. The Senior Manager will lead deal workstreams, build and stress-test tax models, and monitor governance to ensure tax structures are operating as intended with genuine scope for the remit to grow as the function and business scale.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Execution & Structuring

  • Lead the day-to-day tax workstream on live transactions - fundraising and capital raises, infrastructure investments and acquisitions, joint ventures, financing and refinancing.

  • Execute the technical analysis and implementation of tax structures agreed with the VP of Tax, across corporate entities, investments/JVs, and debt and equity financing.

  • Coordinate tax due diligence, documentation and completion mechanics with Finance, Capital Markets, Corporate Development, Legal and external advisers.

  • Review commercial contracts and financing documentation from a tax perspective, flagging issues and options to the VP of Tax.

  • Bring forward clear recommendations on technical questions, with the commercial and risk trade-offs spelled out, for the VP of Tax to decide.

Tax Modelling & Commercial Analysis

  • Own the build and maintenance of tax models and supporting schedules for investments, financing structures and transactions.

  • Model cash-tax outcomes and sensitivities, including:

  • Tax depreciation and capital allowances

  • Interest deductibility and financing scenarios

  • Loss utilisation and group relief

  • Withholding taxes, repatriation and transfer-pricing charges

  • VAT and other indirect-tax cash flows

  • Restructuring, refinancing and exit scenarios

  • Feed agreed tax assumptions into the wider financial models, working closely with Finance and Capital Markets.

  • Pressure-test tax assumptions prepared by internal teams and advisers for technical accuracy and consistency.

  • Translate the tax impact into terms deal teams can use directly – cash flow, valuation and investor returns.

International Tax

  • Provide occasional support to the compliance team as needed, covering gaps or peak periods across the tax compliance calendar.

  • Stay broadly aware of the transfer-pricing policy, permanent-establishment position, withholding-tax/repatriation mechanics and VAT/GST processes, escalating anything relevant from deal or modelling work to the team who owns it.

  • Flag material international tax developments relevant to live deals or models.

Governance & Risk

  • Help operate Volta's tax governance framework and controls on a day-to-day basis and keep the tax risk register current.

  • Build and maintain supporting documentation for tax positions, transactions and intercompany arrangements.

  • Manage the working relationship with Big Four and legal advisers on live matters, escalating scope, cost or quality issues.

  • Support tax authority enquiries, audits and ruling applications.

Business Partnering

  • Act as the day-to-day tax contact for Finance, Legal, Capital Markets, Corporate Development and Strategy on live workstreams.

  • Give practical, timely tax input on new projects and initiatives, translated into cash flow, returns and capital-efficiency impact.

  • Prepare materials and analysis for the VP of Tax ahead of CFO, leadership, investor and lender conversations.

  • Take ownership of agreed workstreams end-to-end, escalating judgement calls and anything strategically significant to the VP of Tax.

Process & Team Support

  • Help the VP of Tax roll out new processes, controls and systems as the function scales.

  • Manage or mentor junior tax analyst/associates as the team grows.

  • Identify opportunities for automation and standardisation in day-to-day tax processes and modelling.

About You

Experience & Qualifications

  • Strong relevant tax experience, typically Big Four Senior Manager to Associate Director level, or the in-house equivalent – someone used to executing complex cross-border deals rather than only advising on them.

  • Professional qualification: CTA, ACA, CA or equivalent.

  • Hands-on experience structuring cross-border investments and financing.

  • Solid technical grounding in international corporate tax – transfer pricing, withholding taxes, permanent establishment and tax-treaty matters.

  • Proven tax-modelling ability, comfortable translating technical rules into cash-flow, valuation and investor-return outputs.

  • Experience coordinating multi-jurisdiction compliance and external advisers.

Skills & Attributes

  • Execution-focused and detail-oriented, with good judgement about what to escalate and when.

  • Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end while operating within a strategy set by someone else.

  • Strong project-management skills, coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders at once.

  • A clear communicator, able to explain complex tax positions to non-tax audiences.

  • Pragmatic and collaborative, energised by building good process in a fast-moving environment.

Desirable Experience

  • Background in private equity, infrastructure funds, real assets, energy or digital infrastructure.

  • Time in a start-up or rapidly scaling international organisation.

  • Exposure to data centres or other capital-intensive infrastructure businesses.

  • Familiarity with UK, European and US tax environments.

  • Experience with tax accounting, provisions and cash-tax forecasting.

As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

About Valiantys 

Valiantys transforms how organizations work by delivering expert solutions that increase enterprise and team agility. Valiantys unlocks the full value of Atlassian’s System of Work, helping customers revolutionize product development, streamline enterprise service management (ESM), and accelerate cloud transformation. Federal and highly regulated organizations trust Valiantys to help them maximize the potential of Atlassian solutions and reach their goals. More information about Valiantys is available at www.valiantys.com.
 

Job summary

Valiantys is looking for a Strategic Account Director to accelerate growth across our most important enterprise clients and prospects.

This role is a senior, services-led growth position for a commercially ambitious leader who can create opportunity at executive level, shape complex transformation agendas and convert them into significant consulting, professional services and long-term managed services relationships.

You will operate at the intersection of client strategy, technology transformation and commercial growth, building trusted relationships with senior executives, identifying where Valiantys can create meaningful business impact and mobilizing the right expertise from across our organization to make it happen.

Your mandate is clear: open doors, create demand, expand strategic relationships and build substantial, sustainable services revenue.

Your impact

Strategic Accounts

For senior sales professionals who are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders, navigating complex organizations and expanding strategic customer relationships over time.

You will build trusted executive relationships, identify transformation priorities, create long-term account strategies and grow the value Valiantys delivers across a customer organization. 

What you will do

Strategic account leadership

  • You will think like the CEO of your accounts.

    That means understanding each client’s strategy, organization, technology landscape, investment priorities, stakeholders and competitive dynamics and translating that intelligence into a deliberate growth strategy.

    You will build and execute account plans that answer three fundamental questions:

    • Where can Valiantys create the greatest value?

    • Who do we need to influence to make that happen?

    • How do we turn that value into sustainable commercial growth?

    You will develop relationships across multiple levels of the client organization, create executive sponsorship, uncover new buying centers and build a strong pipeline of opportunities capable of materially growing each account.

Selling outcomes, not capacity

  • The strongest candidates will understand that sophisticated services sales is not about selling consultants, days or technical resources. It is about selling change and business outcomes.

    You will lead discovery around the client’s most important challenges and ambitions, working with Valiantys’ consulting and technical experts to turn those conversations into propositions that have clear strategic relevance and measurable value.

    Whether the opportunity involves enterprise transformation, ITSM/ESM, cloud, DevOps, platform strategy, AI, operating-model change or managed services, you will ensure the conversation begins with the client’s desired outcome, not the technology.

Orchestrating Valiantys

  • Complex services opportunities are won as a team.

    You will act as the commercial orchestrator for your accounts, bringing together the best of Valiantys across consulting, solution architecture, delivery, customer success, managed services and executive leadership.

    You will create clarity around the client’s ambition, establish a compelling win strategy and ensure our teams are aligned around the outcome we are trying to achieve.

    You will also work closely with Atlassian and our broader partner ecosystem, building strong field relationships and turning platform opportunities into larger transformation and services engagements.

    Your objective is not simply to participate in opportunities. It is to shape them.

Bring commercial discipline

  • Maintain accurate forecasting, qualification and opportunity management throughout the sales cycle.

  • Apply MEDDPICC or a similar methodology to create clarity, momentum and accountability.

  • Contribute to strategic account planning, regional strategy and commercial reporting.

  • Monitor portfolio performance and adjust priorities based on data, market signals and customer engagement.

  • Share insight, best practices and relevant market intelligence with the wider sales organization.

 

What you need to be successful

We are looking for a sophisticated enterprise seller with a strong record of building and closing significant consulting and professional services business with more than 10 years of experience minimum. 

You will bring most of the following:

  • A proven track record of winning complex, high-value professional services, consulting or transformation engagements within enterprise organizations.

  • Evidence of consistently delivering against ambitious services revenue and bookings targets.

  • Strong experience growing strategic accounts and creating substantial new revenue within existing client relationships.

  • The ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders, combining commercial confidence with intellectual curiosity.

  • The ability to move comfortably between strategic business conversations and the commercial detail required to get complex deals signed.

  • Experience creating opportunities where no formal requirement or RFP previously existed.

  • Strong commercial judgment across pricing, scope, margin, contracting, negotiation and deal structure.

  • The ability to navigate complex organizations, political environments and multi-stakeholder buying processes.

  • Experience orchestrating multidisciplinary teams around large pursuits.

  • Strong forecasting, pipeline management and opportunity qualification discipline.

  • Experience within technology consulting, digital transformation, enterprise service management, ITSM, cloud, DevOps, AI transformation or the Atlassian ecosystem would be highly valuable.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to align consultants, delivery teams, partners and executives around a shared opportunity.

If you are ready to develop strategic accounts, achieve ambitious goals, and make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.
 

Why Valiantys?

Valiantys is a fast-growing, international and entrepreneurial organization at the intersection of technology, consulting and business transformation. You will work with experienced specialists who care about the quality of the outcome—not just the signature of the contract.

What we offer

  • An international, multicultural team and a genuinely European scope.

  • A flexible telework program.

  • Personal dental plan and health insurance fully funded by Valiantys.

  • Choice of PC or Mac.

  • Training time and budget to support your development.

Ready to create momentum?

If you are looking for a role where you can combine enterprise selling, strategic thinking and real customer impact, we would like to hear from you.

Whether your strength is expanding strategic accounts or opening new enterprise relationships, you will have the opportunity to shape markets, build meaningful partnerships and directly influence the growth of Valiantys and our customers.

Great salespeople create opportunities. Exceptional ones create momentum.

About AQEMIA

AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs. At the core of our mission is QEMI, our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.
 
What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing never-before-seen molecules, without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization, targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.
 
For more information, visit AQEMIA.com, our WTTJ Page, and our LinkedIn. 
 

About our Team

AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery.
 
This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.
 

About our Engineering Department

The Engineering team (~12 people) builds and scales the technical foundations that power Aqemia’s drug discovery engine.
 
Bringing together expertise across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and scientific computing, the team designs and operates robust, secure, and high-performance platforms that enable Aqemia’s scientific and AI teams to experiment, train, deploy, and run models at scale.
 
Their work spans data infrastructure, scientific compute systems, cloud operations, orchestration, observability, CI/CD, developer tooling, and platform scalability. By transforming cutting-edge research into reliable and scalable systems, the team accelerates the discovery of new medicines while ensuring operational excellence and an outstanding developer experience.

The role

As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll own AQEMIA's data platform end to end — from ingestion through the pipeline to the trusted, model-ready datasets that power science, ML and analytics. What makes this role distinctive is the data itself: chemical structures, molecular conformations, physics- and ML-based predictions, and experimental results from CROs and partners.

A core part of the work is modelling these scientific entities well — establishing canonical identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous, often messy sources — so scientists, and increasingly AI agents, can rely on them. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering, data infrastructure and scientific research, with real scope to shape architecture rather than just execute against it.

As AQEMIA moves toward more service and API-driven integration next year, you'll help make data fit for automation — expanding your impact from pipelines to the systems that consume them.


Responsibilities
  • Own AQEMIA's Bronze → Silver → Gold data pipelines end to end, from ingestion through transformation and delivery, maintaining lineage and traceability as data volume and complexity grow.
  • Model canonical scientific entities — compounds, structures, assays, predictions — establishing identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous and often messy sources.
  • Set and uphold data quality standards through monitoring, validation, testing and alerting across critical pipelines, strengthening governance and observability so datasets stay trusted and accessible.
  • Partner with ML engineers, data scientists and researchers to build curated, model-ready datasets, translating scientific and business requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Drive data architecture and engineering best practices — data modeling, testing, documentation, orchestration and deployment — in collaboration with the Engineering Manager and Staff Data Engineer on roadmap execution.
  • Build self-service capabilities and, looking ahead, APIs that make data fit for automation as AQEMIA moves toward more service-based integration.
  • Uphold engineering quality through code reviews, and mentor junior engineers by sharing knowledge and best practices as a senior individual contributor.

    • Qualifications
  • Deep experience in data engineering, with a track record of production systems that other teams depend on. We care about what you have built, not the year count. 
  • Strong software engineering skills. You code, you review code, and you hold a quality bar.
  • Expert in Python and SQL. - Strong data modelling and relational database experience. You can defend an identity key.
  • Production experience with a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake) and a transformation framework (we use dbt).
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (we use Airflow) and infrastructure-as-code (we use Terraform on AWS).
  • Any STEM degree or equivalent experience.

    • Nice-to-have
  • Experience with AWS.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and modern data warehousing (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and object storage.
  • Experience in drug discovery, biotech, pharma or deeptech environments.
  • Exposure to AI-driven or data-intensive workflows, or experience working across disciplines (e.g. biology ↔ ML ↔ chemistry).
  • Experience implementing data governance, lineage and metadata management solutions.
  • Track record of improving platform scalability, reliability and operational maturity.

    • Our recruitment process
    1. First discussion with our Talent Acquisition
    2. Hiring Manager’s interview: you’ll meet directly with your future manager
    3. Technical assessment of your skills in a deep-dive interview with the team
    4. VP interview to share wider team vision and align motivations
    5. Cultural fit interview with our co-founder and COO, Emmanuelle
    6. Final interview with our co-founder and CEO, Maximillien

    Why Join Us? 

    At AQEMIA, we work for a mission: joining us means having your own impact on changing the way drugs are discovered, and helping to shape the direction of our fast-growing company and team.
    Expanding Drug Discovery Pipeline : Focused on critical therapeutic areas like Oncology, CNS, Immuno-inflammation... with in vivo proof of concept/patent stage programs. Collaborations with top Pharma, including a $140M Sanofi deal.
    World-Class Interdisciplinary Team : work alongside exceptional talent at the intersection of technology and life sciences. Our teams combine deep expertise in AI, physics-based modeling, biology, and medicinal chemistry to push the boundaries of innovation.
    DeepTech Recognition: AQEMIA is proud to be part of the French Tech 40 and France 2030, highlighting our role as a key player in Europe’s DeepTech ecosystem.
    Prime Location with Flexibility : Our offices are located in the heart of Paris and London (King’s Cross), with flexible work arrangements including up to two remote days per week.

jobs.description:
About H:

H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.

The Role

Today, H is known for its story: its founders, its funding rounds, its press. We want it to be known for its value. Your mission is to make H one of the top 3 brands that large-enterprise decision-makers think of in enterprise AI, in France first, then in the US.

You will be our Brand lead, and the owner of the Brand pillar of our marketing strategy, alongside Growth and Product Marketing. You'll take over a brand foundation that is being shaped right now (positioning, identity, messaging house) and turn it into a brand that holds for the next five years in a market that reinvents itself every quarter.

Our brand stance is that of a pragmatic visionary: bold on vision, precise and evidence-led on capability. You'll be the guardian of that balance, making sure every piece of work speaks the language of the boardroom and holds up to the scrutiny of a CTO/builder.

You'll work hand in hand with leadership, Product, Research, Sales, our FDE teams and Communications, and with our external brand and PR agencies.

What You'll Do

Lead the brand relaunch (Foundations)

  • Take ownership of the new brand platform: positioning, identity, tone of voice and messaging house, and drive its rollout internally and externally.

  • Turn our convictions into a story that is ours: what we believe, why we exist, what makes our approach to enterprise problems unique.

  • Build a brand system that flexes by market (France, UK, US) without losing coherence, and that separates our two registers: a bold "vision voice" and a precise "capability voice".

  • Set and enforce brand guidelines across every touchpoint: website, decks, events, product, recruiting.

Shift the narrative (Reputation)

  • Move the public conversation about H from founders and funding to product, value and customer outcomes.

  • Make trust a brand signal: reliability, ownership, resilience and our research-first approach (we own our models, we are not a wrapper), carried through proof rather than claims.

  • Co-own reputation with Communications: Brand defines the positioning, Communications amplifies it through PR and executive voice.

Build awareness where our buyers are (Awareness)

  • Design the brand plan that puts H in front of large-account decision-makers: flagship events, recurring PR moments, ecosystem programmes, content and campaigns.

  • Prepare and lead the brand side of our US launch.

  • Partner with Growth so awareness turns into qualified relationships and pipeline.

Earn authority (Authority)

  • Grow H's thought leadership around the execution gap in enterprise AI and "AI that actually works".

  • Lead strategic sponsorships and labels (e.g. Institut Polytechnique de Paris, our Resilient AI label) and partnerships with academics and consulting firms.

Build the function

  • Manage brand budget and agencies (brand studio, freelancers).

  • Hire and lead the Brand team as it grows, starting with a Content Manager.

How We'll Measure Success

Your north-star metric is the Brand Awareness Index (BAI), measured on our target audiences only: decision-makers at large accounts (SBF 120 in France, Fortune 500 in the US), from business C-levels to "the builders" (CIOs, CTOs, architects, data and engineering leads).

The index combines aided awareness, unaided awareness and consideration of H in enterprise AI, tracked quarterly by market. Your first milestone is to set its baseline, since none exists today.

Horizon Target First 90 days BAI baseline set in France and the US; brand platform rolled out France Top 3 in aided awareness among SBF 120 decision-makers, then Top 3 in unaided awareness US Top 5 in aided awareness among Fortune 500 decision-makers, then Top 3 in unaided awareness within 2 years for AI for enterprise

Supporting indicators: share of voice versus competitors, and the share of H mentions about product and value rather than founders and funding.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in brand, marketing or communications, including for a B2B tech company

  • You have led a brand repositioning or relaunch end to end, from strategy to rollout, and can show what it changed.

  • You have built awareness among enterprise decision-makers, and you have measured it (brand tracking, share of voice, consideration).

  • You understand deep tech well enough to translate it for a board without dumbing it down, and to defend it in front of engineers.

  • You are as comfortable with a CEO and a leadership team as with a brand studio or a PR agency, and you know how to brief, challenge and arbitrate.

  • You think in systems and act in details: a clear strategy, a sharp eye for craft, and a bias for shipping.

  • Fluent English is required; French is a strong plus.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

  • You have built a brand in an emerging category, where the words themselves were still being defined.

  • You have worked across Europe and the US and know how a story needs to flex from one market to the other.

  • You care about proof: case studies, customer voices and numbers matter more to you than slogans.

  • You are low ego and high ownership, and you like building a team and a function from the ground up.

Location

Paris/London, hybrid: 3 days a week on average in our office (8 rue Sainte-Cécile, 75009) or with customers. Regular travel to London and the US.

What We Offer

  • Join the early days of one of Europe's most ambitious AI companies, and shape how the world sees it.

  • Real ownership: a seat at the table with leadership and a function to build.

  • A team of world-class researchers, engineers and operators who ship.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Benefits: health insurance, meal vouchers, transport

    If you want to change the status quo in AI, join us.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey? 
 
At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
 
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
 
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

Driving Revenue Growth and Strategic Client Expansion

As a Senior Client Partner, you will play a key role in driving commercial growth and expanding Aleph's footprint in Switzerland, directly contributing to revenue generation, portfolio expansion, and long-term strategic client partnerships.

This is a revenue-driven, commercially focused role. You will own a book of business, identify new growth opportunities, and position Aleph as a strategic partner within the Swiss digital advertising ecosystem.


What You Will Do

Revenue Growth and Portfolio Expansion

  • Sell Microsoft Advertising solutions to both new and existing advertisers.
  • Proactively generate new leads, build a robust sales pipeline, and maintain accurate CRM records of all sales activities.
  • Consistently achieve sales targets while delivering a high-quality customer sales experience.
  • Accurately forecast weekly, monthly, and annual revenue performance.

    • Strategic Client Leadership

  • Build and maintain a strong network of contacts across key verticals through industry events, outreach, and market engagement.
  • Engage regularly with new and existing clients to understand campaign objectives, KPIs, and future marketing plans.
  • Recommend tailored solutions from the product portfolio to help clients achieve their business and marketing goals.
  • Lead onboarding processes for new clients, including guiding them through legal and compliance requirements.

    • Market and Cross-Functional Impact

  • Stay up to date with market trends and competitor activity to identify new business opportunities.
  • Introduce Aleph to new prospects and expand presence across target industries.
  • Collaborate closely with Client Solutions Managers (Account Managers) to ensure smooth campaign launches and execution.
  • Provide timely, actionable feedback to clients to optimize performance and strengthen relationships.

    • What We Are Looking For
  • 3+ years of digital advertising experience, in business development, account management, key account management, or ad sales.
  • Strong understanding of the Swiss advertising ecosystem, with an established network across key industry players and stakeholders, particularly within media agencies, as well as advertisers and publishers.
  • Strong commercial skills, with direct responsibility for revenue.
  • Direct experience in paid search advertising (SEM), performance advertising, and e-commerce.
  • The ability to work independently and set your own workflows to achieve sales targets, including in a fully remote setup.
  • Right to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit).
  • Fluency in French and English. French is a plus.

    • How Success Looks

    As a Senior Client Partner at Aleph, success means driving real business results for clients while making a measurable impact on the team and the company. You will know you are thriving when:

  • Clients trust you as a strategic partner, seeing tangible growth and measurable improvements in their campaigns and overall performance.
  • You consistently hit or exceed your individual revenue and performance targets while contributing to the collective goals of the team.
  • You identify opportunities for expansion, optimizing strategies and processes to deliver smarter, more efficient campaigns.
  • You actively bring in new clients and business opportunities, closing deals that fuel both client growth and Aleph's market expansion.
  • You actively collaborate, share knowledge, and bring innovative ideas that improve outcomes for clients and the team alike.

    • What You Get at Aleph
  • Impact: You will own a book of business and shape how Swiss advertisers use Microsoft Advertising, with results you can measure in revenue and client growth.
  • Growth: Move across teams, take on new responsibilities, and expand your expertise within a network that represents 55+ leading digital platforms.
  • Team culture: Join a collaborative, innovative team that encourages initiative, creativity, and ownership, and that welcomes people from every background.
  • Market context: Switzerland is a premium advertising market, worth CHF 4.1 billion in net advertising revenue in 2025, with online advertising as its largest segment.
  • Flexibility and wellbeing: Work fully remotely from Switzerland, with global exposure and a benefits package designed to support your personal development and quality of life.
    • Why Join Us?
     
    Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.  
     
    We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together. 
     
    #ALEPH

jobs.title: Director, International Privacy Lead and Data Protection Officer
Project Planner (Data Centres/Buildings/High-tech/Infrastructure) -  Frankfurt/Berlin/Munich (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Are you a bit tired of the standard, old-fashioned way of doing things in the construction industry? 
Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more efficiently using a good dose of common sense and maybe a bit of technology? 
Have you always cared about the importance of proper planning and the connection between the schedule and the real, day-to-day delivery of the job? 
Have you ever wanted to work a bit more flexibly but still be hands-on in construction and improving the industry? 
Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t. It’s quite real! Read on. 
____________________________________________________________
We are Laminar Projects!
 
If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered.
 
Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Check out our short film about it.)
We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.)
 
The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and missions.)
 
This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. 
 
(Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos.)
 
Core values for a good life
 
A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has:
 
- Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself 
- Care about people – your relationship with others around you 
- Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team 
- Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world 
 
We enshrined our values in our vision:
 
We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that:
 
- Connects us with meaningful relationships 
- Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans 
- Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 
 
By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.
 
And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions:
 
- To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation 
- To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society 
____________________________________________________________
The Role 
 
Purpose of the role 
 
You’ll be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning to the very highest standards. You’ll devise strategies and tactics to improve the way the project is delivered. You’ll translate this knowledge into a logic-linked plan and analyse it using planning software. Then you’ll use the plan to help the teams understand what to prioritise. 
 
Your team 
 
This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy team which focuses on:
 
- Understanding what the real problems of projects are 
- Implementing the best solutions to those problems 
- Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology 
 
More specifically, you’ll be part of our Project Planning Team, who are industry leaders in the planning of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors.
 
Your top three objectives 
 
1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection 
2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems 
3. To develop yourself and everyone around you 
 
Your top five responsibilities 
 
1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project is working to it effectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially 
2. Own the outcome: You're responsible for putting in your best effort to ensure the project team’s understanding and focus on the plan – no matter how stubborn they are 
3. Report and inform: Provide simple, actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that help them deliver their part of the project more efficiently and effectively 
4. Make scalable solutions: Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools in collaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved 
5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well  
 
You must have:
 
- A construction engineering background: You have at least 2+ years of experience on construction projects, experience in project planning both software and principles, as well as decent Excel skills, and a strong interest in data
- Communication skills: You’re proficient in written and verbal English and have the charisma and influence to get construction people to do new things and take the best approach 
- Leadership capabilities: You lead yourself proactively and lead others by asking the right questions and challenging them 
- Impact: You have a track record of making projects and organisations better beyond just doing the basics – implementing scalable, repeatable solutions that had a significant positive impact 
 
Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: 
 
- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge 
- You like to be the smartest person in the room 
- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback 
- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
____________________________________________________________
Frequently Asked Questions 
 
What kinds of projects would I be working on?
It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres, infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects. These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. (Check out our case stories.) 
 
Who are our clients?
Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. 
 
Where would I be working?
One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. 
 
How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? 
You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry. 
 
The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. 
 
____________________________________________________________
 
Benefits
 
The standard stuff: 
 
- Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance 
- Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft 
 
The life-changing stuff:
 
- In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
- Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future - and own a piece of it
- Flexible working. Work where it makes sense - most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins
- Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up
____________________________________________________________
 
Important! Applying properly
 
We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:
 
- Why you want to join us 
- What you’ll bring to the team 
 
We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix.  
 
This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility.
